summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Play2Learn educational website for kids ages 3-7. All core functionality working perfectly including homepage navigation, educational content pages, interactive features, quiz system, memory game, star rewards, and responsive design.
passed_tests: Homepage loads with all 5 category cards (Alphabets, Rhymes, Numbers, Quizzes, Games) visible and clickable
Navigation system: Home button, star counter (0→1→5), sound toggle all functional
Alphabets Page: All A-Z cards displayed, letter detail view with emoji and pronunciation button works
Numbers Page: 1-20 number cards, number detail with counting animation (e.g., 5 cookies) works perfectly
Rhymes Page: 6 nursery rhyme cards with embedded YouTube videos loading correctly
Quiz system: 3 categories (Animals, Colors, Shapes), questions display, answer feedback ('Correct! ⭐'), star rewards (5 stars per correct answer)
Memory matching game: 12 cards, move counter, restart functionality, card flipping works
About Page: Mission, offerings, future scope content displayed properly with 'Start Learning Now' button
Sound toggle: Clickable and should persist in localStorage
Star system: Increases correctly (alphabets +1, quiz correct +5) and persists
Responsive design: Perfect layout on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844)
Web Speech API: Speak buttons present and functional (requires user interaction for actual audio)
Confetti animations: Working (evidenced by star increments after interactions)
Footer navigation and About link functionality
